objective: Make HolyAgent install with plugin commands only (two marketplace adds and one plugin install), moving setup and doctor into the plugin runtime, adding /holyagent:setup and a SessionStart setup check, deleting packages/cli, shrinking the installers, and fixing the Windows long-path install by moving .holyagent state off main.
requirements: User installs with exactly: `claude plugin marketplace add davidbasilefilho/holyagent`, `claude plugin marketplace add ranxianglei/billion-context`, `claude plugin install holyagent@holyagent`; no clone, no `bun install`, no `holyagent setup claude`. Prerequisites left: Bun on PATH, Node LTS, git, authenticated gh.

1. Everything packages/cli does in `setup claude` and `doctor` moves into the plugin runtime (scripts/holyagent.js) as `holyagent setup` and `holyagent doctor [--fix]`: install Billion Context (bili, native mode, compress.rules) and ctx7 with its skill; merge recommended keys (attribution, includeGitInstructions, subagentPromptCacheTtl, extraKnownMarketplaces, enabledPlugins, permissions.deny) into USER settings (~/.claude/settings.json, %USERPROFILE%/.claude/settings.json on Windows); never change a value already set; keep the existing +/=/~/! report lines; doctor checks user settings, not ./.claude/settings.json.
